claims: Mick Cronin is the head coach of the UCLA men's basketball team.
Mick Cronin has led the Bruins since April 2019.
Mick Cronin has led the UCLA men's basketball team to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
Mick Cronin led the UCLA men's basketball team to a Final Four run in 2021.
Mick Cronin previously coached at Cincinnati.
Mick Cronin previously coached at Murray State.
As of March 2026, Mick Cronin's position is The Michael Price Family UCLA Men's Head Basketball Coach.
As of March 2026, Mick Cronin has over 160 wins at UCLA.
As of March 2026, Mick Cronin has a winning percentage over .680 at UCLA.
Mick Cronin is the 2020 Pac-12 Coach of the Year.
Mick Cronin led UCLA to the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Darren Savino is Associate HC on the UCLA men's basketball coaching staff.
Rod Palmer is an assistant on the UCLA men's basketball coaching staff.
Nate Georgeton is an assistant on the UCLA men's basketball coaching staff.
Cori Close is the Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach
